title.fi: VERBITYYPPI 1: KUINKA PALJON TÄMÄ PAITA MAKSAA?
title.en: Verb type 1: how much does this shirt cost?

summary: Verb type 1 explained with maksaa (to cost/pay), including negative and 'how much' questions, followed by 20 English prompts to ask prices of clothes and food in Finnish.
transcript:
VERBITYYPPI 1: KUINKA PALJON TÄMÄ PAITA MAKSAA? (maksaa= to cost, to pay)

1) verb type 1 ends in two vowels: another one + the very last letter A/Ä

2) to start using it, you remove the last A/Ä and add a personal ending: MAKSA/A > minä maksan, sinä maksat, hän maksaa, me maksamme, te maksatte, he maksavat, paita maksaa 10 euroa

3) for the negative, you take the verb in its ”MINÄ”-form (MINÄ MAKSAN) and remove the last ”N” and you have the verb in the form you use it in a negative sentence: Minä en maksa laskua= I will not pay the bill. Hedelmät eivät maksa paljon= The fruit(s) don’t cost a lot.

HOW MUCH?= KUINKA PALJON? PALJONKO? or even MITÄ TÄMÄ MAKSAA?= What does this cost? Se maksaa kaksi euroa= It costs 2 euros. Ne maksavat kuusi euroa= They cost six euros.

Kuinka kysyt:

1. How much does this jacket cost? (38e)

2. How much do these shoes cost? (120e)

3. How much does this green scarf cost? (17,95e) -Oh, it is cheap! (cheap= halpa)

4. How much do these red jeans cost? (96e)

5. How much do these black gloves cost? (18,65e)

6. How much do these long, red leggings cost? (25e)

7. How much does this fun baseball hat cost? (13,50e) (fun= hauska, baseball hat= lippis)

8. How much do these big overalls cost? (135e) (overalls= haalarit)

9. How much does this short, black skirt cost? (47,80e) - It is expensive! (expensive= kallis)

10. How much do these white Adidas-sneakers cost? (117,60e) (Adidas-tossut)

11. How much do the foreign fruit(s) cost? (foreign= ulkomaalainen)

12. How much is the domestic salmon a kilo? - It costs 9,80e a kilo. (domestic= kotimainen)

13. How much does your vegetarian pizza cost? (18,40e)

14. How much do these red apples cost? (3,60e a kilo)

15. How much do the carrots cost? (1,60 a bag)

16. How much does your chicken salad cost? (9,30e)

17. How much do those over there berries cost? (12,30e a litre) those= nuo

18. How much do those buns cost? (1,90e apiece) apiece= kappale

19. How much does a bag of licorice cost? (4,99e) (bag= pussi; licorice= lakritsi)

20. How much are those white candles? (11,50 a packet) (candle= kynttilä; packet= paketti)

grammar_notes.heading: Verbityyppi 1: maksaa
grammar_notes.text: Verb type 1 ends in two vowels, the last being A/Ä. Remove the last A/Ä and add the personal ending: MAKSA/A > minä maksan... Negative: take the minä-form, remove the final N: minä en maksa laskua (I will not pay the bill); hedelmät eivät maksa paljon (the fruit don't cost a lot).

grammar_notes.heading: How much?
grammar_notes.text: HOW MUCH? = KUINKA PALJON? / PALJONKO? / MITÄ TÄMÄ MAKSAA? (What does this cost?) Se maksaa kaksi euroa = It costs 2 euros. Ne maksavat kuusi euroa = They cost six euros.
